nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Test workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: No npm, no dependencies: tests load the shipped public/*.js directly.

nodes.label: Verify presentation changes by looking (screenshot/DOM), suspect markup first
nodes.rationale: Code can be correct and the pixel wrong or invisible.
nodes.norm_label: verify presentation changes by looking (screenshot/dom), suspect markup first

nodes.label: Constraint 1: literal style= attribute (property:{{ value }})
nodes.rationale: CSS property names are read from literal attribute text at compile time; a hole holding 'width:13px' compiles to an empty style silently.

nodes.label: Constraint 2: dynamic src/href/points via ref callback after mount
nodes.rationale: The browser HTML parser loads them before JS runs.
nodes.norm_label: constraint 2: dynamic src/href/points via ref callback after mount

nodes.label: Constraint 3: window.CASA_CONFIG global, not a module
nodes.rationale: import() is blocked under file:// where demo mode runs.
nodes.norm_label: constraint 3: window.casa_config global, not a module

nodes.label: Constraint 4: panel_custom tag derived from folder (live_dashboard-panel under HACS)
nodes.rationale: Getting it wrong produced a silent black screen.
nodes.norm_label: constraint 4: panel_custom tag derived from folder (live_dashboard-panel under hacs)

nodes.label: Constraint 5: flat HA energy schema for grid source
nodes.norm_label: constraint 5: flat ha energy schema for grid source

nodes.label: Constraint 6: never the same expression in two sc-if with opposite hint-placeholder-val
nodes.rationale: Both branches rendered in the live DOM (v1.8.1, Ultime azioni); negated branch must get its own name from renderVals() (noDiagActionRows).
nodes.norm_label: constraint 6: never the same expression in two sc-if with opposite hint-placeholder-val

nodes.label: Dove va il codice (v2)
nodes.rationale: Logic lives once in casa-core.js; pages contain only layout.

nodes.label: casa-core.js loaded in <head> before support.js, classic script with page ?v=
nodes.rationale: Runtime evaluates the component class right after React; classic script rather than ES module because of constraint 3.
nodes.norm_label: casa-core.js loaded in <head> before support.js, classic script with page ?v=

nodes.label: Test fails if a page redefines a base method
nodes.norm_label: test fails if a page redefines a base method

nodes.label: Density before 'fits in one screen' (44 px targets, 10 px text)
nodes.rationale: 1280x800 no-scroll constraint retired in v1.4.9: with 12 rooms and 4 cameras inner scroll is accepted; never compress typography, touch targets or spacing.
nodes.norm_label: density before 'fits in one screen' (44 px targets, 10 px text)

nodes.label: Energy role colors: --sage self-consumption, --acc import, --feed export
nodes.rationale: Ring and bars must share the same grammar; divergence is a bug.
nodes.norm_label: energy role colors: --sage self-consumption, --acc import, --feed export

nodes.label: Session orientation: graphify wiki/GRAPH_REPORT, graphify query, latest CHANGELOG entry
nodes.norm_label: session orientation: graphify wiki/graph_report, graphify query, latest changelog entry

nodes.label: Regenerate graphify and commit graphify-out/ with code changes
nodes.rationale: graphify-out is the repo map; if it lags it describes a version that no longer exists.
nodes.norm_label: regenerate graphify and commit graphify-out/ with code changes

nodes.label: Node count is not a regression signal; verify coverage by symbol grep
nodes.rationale: Extraction is semantic and distributed (492 -> 571 -> 615 -> 513 across growing releases).
nodes.norm_label: node count is not a regression signal; verify coverage by symbol grep

nodes.label: No graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Hook does an AST-only rebuild after commit and overwrites the semantic graph with a poorer one (254 vs 298 nodes).

nodes.label: Release rules (user config outside HACS folder, single VERSION in panel.js, v-prefixed tags)
nodes.norm_label: release rules (user config outside hacs folder, single version in panel.js, v-prefixed tags)

nodes.label: A tag is not a release: push tag + gh release create with CHANGELOG notes
nodes.rationale: HACS shows releases, not tags; a tag without release reaches nobody. Verify live_dashboard.zip asset.
nodes.norm_label: a tag is not a release: push tag + gh release create with changelog notes

nodes.label: Diagnostics must be visible in dashboard, not only console
nodes.rationale: Most users are on companion app or wall tablets where console.log doesn't exist.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostics must be visible in dashboard, not only console

nodes.label: Live Dashboard — irrigation safety close (automation blueprint)
nodes.rationale: The dashboard's timed close needs at least one open dashboard; this runs inside HA so it covers zero open dashboards, a powered-off tablet, or a hand-opened valve. Set max a bit above the longest dashboard duration (e.g. 5/10/15 -> 20 min). A for: timer doesn't survive restart, hence the start trigger.
nodes.norm_label: live dashboard — irrigation safety close (automation blueprint)

nodes.label: Restart sweep closing still-open switches and valves
nodes.norm_label: restart sweep closing still-open switches and valves

nodes.label: dash_neumo.html (desktop layout)
nodes.rationale: Desktop/wall-tablet layout (1280x800 preview). In v2 shared logic moved to casa-core.js; this page keeps template, initial state and a layout-specific renderVals().

nodes.label: Head script loading order
nodes.rationale: Order: vendored React UMD -> window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE -> document.write loader for ./casa-core.js?v= -> ./support.js. casa-core must define window.CasaCore before support.js and the x-dc script run; plain tags because import() is blocked under file:// (demo mode).

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 UMD scripts
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React ships with the dashboard; support.js loadReactUmd() skips its CDN fetch when window.React/ReactDOM exist. Versioned file names instead of ?v= since react@18.3.1 content never changes. Missing vendor file falls back to CDN.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE
nodes.rationale: Records 'local' vs 'cdn' React source for Diagnostica -> Ambiente.

nodes.label: document.write loader for casa-core.js?v=
nodes.rationale: Reuses the page's own ?v= query param (same as bust()) so casa-core.js is cache-busted together with the page; document.write keeps it synchronous and before support.js.

nodes.label: Local @font-face rules (Caprasimo, Figtree)
nodes.rationale: Fonts served from ./vendor/fonts/ so the dashboard starts without internet (v1.9.0 offline assets).

nodes.label: sc-if / sc-for templating
nodes.rationale: Custom x-dc templating: sc-if with hint-placeholder-val, sc-for with hint-placeholder-count. style= property names are read from literal text at compile time; src/href/points bound via _bindAttr ref callbacks.

nodes.norm_label: rendervals: header (greeting, modes, weather, people, connection status)

nodes.norm_label: rendervals: casasections and energy card variant

nodes.norm_label: rendervals: quick actions (lights off, covers up/down)

nodes.rationale: Entity hide applied before summaries; pill priority alarm > openings > presence > temperature > humidity > rest; per-domain busy semantics (lock unlocked, valve open, siren on).

nodes.label: Camera live view via WebRTC (first layer)
nodes.rationale: WebRTC from HA (built-in go2rtc or the camera integration) is used first: first frame measured at 1.0 s on the tablet and 0.76 s on the phone vs ~12 s with HLS, which must start the stream and build segments; 'Preload stream' no longer needed for fast opening
nodes.norm_label: camera live view via webrtc (first layer)

nodes.label: Same WebRTC handshake as HA frontend (camera/webrtc/offer)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors HA frontend 2026.11: client config, receive-only peer connection, offer via camera/webrtc/offer subscription, ICE candidates both directions; video stays muted
nodes.norm_label: same webrtc handshake as ha frontend (camera/webrtc/offer)

nodes.label: Automatic WebRTC to HLS fallback with reason in Diagnostica
nodes.rationale: HA error, failed ICE or no frame within 12 s falls back to hls.js, native HLS, stills; Diagnostica → Telecamere shows active layer and why it fell back (e.g. 'hls.js · fell back after WebRTC')
nodes.norm_label: automatic webrtc to hls fallback with reason in diagnostica

nodes.label: HA bridge supports subscriptions (not only request/response)
nodes.rationale: panel.js forwards HA events to the iframe as they arrive; explicitly limited to camera WebRTC commands; open subscriptions close on page reload or panel close
nodes.norm_label: ha bridge supports subscriptions (not only request/response)

nodes.label: WebRTC handshake simulation test (33 tests total)
nodes.rationale: Simulates whole handshake: candidates held until session, answer, error, fallback, close
nodes.norm_label: webrtc handshake simulation test (33 tests total)

nodes.label: Shared core public/casa-core.js
nodes.rationale: Desktop and mobile pages each had a full copy (85/86 methods identical, ~800 identical lines in renderVals()); every fix had to be done twice and comments had diverged. Pages shrink from 4,580/3,677 to 2,643/2,124 lines

nodes.label: Shared renderVals view-model blocks (vmSettingsDiag, vmAlarm, vmCameraDetail, vmEnergyRing, vmHourlyStrip, vmEnergyEmpty, vmLiveConsumption)
nodes.rationale: Each page keeps only its layout: template, initial state and its own renderVals() that assembles common blocks
nodes.norm_label: shared rendervals view-model blocks (vmsettingsdiag, vmalarm, vmcameradetail, vmenergyring, vmhourlystrip, vmenergyempty, vmliveconsumption)

nodes.label: renderVals() before/after verification on 378 combinations
nodes.rationale: 9 demo scenarios × 2 layouts × 21 UI states compared identical; only intended diff is extra thumbColor field in mobile settings room rows

nodes.label: version.json read by panel.js as iframe ?v=
nodes.rationale: Bypasses HA's 31-day /local/ cache so page updates reach tablets without changing module_url or restarting HA, unless panel.js itself changes
nodes.norm_label: version.json read by panel.js as iframe ?v=

nodes.label: support.js treated as frozen dependency (hash pinned by test)
nodes.rationale: Its source (dc-runtime/) is not in the repo, so it is not modified; a test pins its hash like vendor/ files
nodes.norm_label: support.js treated as frozen dependency (hash pinned by test)

nodes.label: Node test suite (node --test) and CI workflow test.yml
nodes.rationale: Dependency-free tests: section order, visibility, smart plugs, Matter duplicates, discoverRooms discard reasons, vendor integrity, no external resources, it/en key parity, VERSION vs CHANGELOG; grew 20 → 32 → 33; also forbids a page redefining a core method
nodes.norm_label: node test suite (node --test) and ci workflow test.yml

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 runtime in public/vendor/
nodes.rationale: Dashboard silently depended on internet: support.js fetched React from unpkg each load, risking a blank tablet offline; vendored files are byte-identical (SHA-384 matches SRI), CDN kept as fallback

nodes.label: Vendored Caprasimo/Figtree web fonts
nodes.rationale: Removes Google Fonts dependency; variable Figtree covers all weights including real 500; zero external requests at startup

nodes.label: Differential state push casa:hass-states-delta
nodes.rationale: Full hass.states copy every 600 ms (~175 KB, 666 entities) replaced by changed entities only, compared by reference; measured 30 s → 4 messages, ~14 KB; full snapshot every 5 min and on iframe reload as safety net

nodes.label: Camera live layer order: hls.js first, native HLS only where hls.js can't run
nodes.rationale: Chrome answers 'maybe' to canPlayType for HLS but its native player is least predictable; same choice as HA frontend
nodes.norm_label: camera live layer order: hls.js first, native hls only where hls.js can't run

nodes.label: Camera runtime fallback between live layers
nodes.rationale: A layer failing while playing drops to the next instead of leaving a black 'Live' box; Diagnostica → Telecamere says which layer it fell back from and why
nodes.norm_label: camera runtime fallback between live layers

nodes.label: Stable per-stream ref callback, muted video, sequential still loading
nodes.rationale: A new ref callback every render reset src (14 reloads in 10 s); React ignored muted; still URL changed every 400 ms cancelling loads on slow cameras
nodes.norm_label: stable per-stream ref callback, muted video, sequential still loading

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad
nodes.rationale: Panels declaring code_format get a 64 px numeric keypad or password field; code never stored, logged in Recent actions or copied in diagnostics; demo scenario alarm-pin (code 1234)

nodes.label: Irrigation safety close blueprint
nodes.rationale: Runs inside HA and closes valves left open past a max time (default 20 min) and at HA restart, covering the zero-open-dashboards gap declared in 1.8.1; handles switch.* and valve.*

nodes.label: Vendored hls.js 1.7.4 (hls.light.min.js)
nodes.rationale: Loaded only when a camera live view opens; previously that layer was written but always inactive; React was already a CDN runtime dependency, so the 1.5.4 'first third-party dependency' objection did not hold

nodes.label: call() single choke point for service calls
nodes.rationale: A support issue ('buttons don't respond, zero console errors') showed nothing ever read the service call outcome; call() never rejects so it stays safe without await
nodes.norm_label: call() single choke point for service calls

nodes.label: Diagnostica → Ultime azioni / Recent actions ring buffer
nodes.rationale: Session ring buffer (last 20) of outcome ok/error/timeout and duration; the section to paste into issues; errors/timeouts also toast
nodes.norm_label: diagnostica → ultime azioni / recent actions ring buffer

nodes.label: Timeout errors marked with .code = 'timeout'
nodes.rationale: Recognize timeout by code instead of matching an Italian string

nodes.label: Irrigation state from the valve, not the button
nodes.norm_label: irrigation state from the valve, not the button

nodes.label: Persisted irrigation deadline in frontend/user_data
nodes.rationale: Timed close no longer depends only on a setTimeout in the tab that started it; checked every 15 s by any open client; still insufficient with zero dashboards open

nodes.label: Hourly 24-bar history strip under the energy ring
nodes.rationale: Same grammar as the ring, linear instead of radial; data from recorder/statistics_during_period hourly on existing statistic_ids; absent stats leave card unchanged and reason shown in Diagnostica
nodes.norm_label: hourly 24-bar history strip under the energy ring

nodes.label: Cover real position band in room panel
nodes.rationale: Read-only band, no new interactive surface; never fakes a position when current_position is absent
nodes.norm_label: cover real position band in room panel

nodes.label: Discovery discard reason logging (N entities not shown)
nodes.rationale: Wall-tablet users have no console, so discovery discards were invisible; every discard point now logs why, grouped by actionability in Diagnostica
nodes.norm_label: discovery discard reason logging (n entities not shown)

nodes.label: Matter duplicate-serial device warning (HA 2026.9.0)
nodes.rationale: HA 2026.9.0 re-registered Matter devices as area-less duplicates, making covers vanish; copies paired by serial number, not name

nodes.label: Home section order (sections.order)
nodes.rationale: One linear order shared by desktop and mobile; up/down arrows instead of drag to avoid colliding with long-press-to-hide; unknown sections fused near default neighbours

nodes.label: Derived house consumption
nodes.rationale: Removes manual template sensor; shows '—' rather than a partial sum; labeled 'calculated' everywhere

nodes.label: Battery sign convention self-diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Rolling window detects mostly-negative derived values and raises a named verdict with one-tap invert; never shows a negative consumption

nodes.label: Self-explanatory empty states (Go to Areas, missing energy entity ID)
nodes.rationale: Replace silent blanks with the cause: no entity resolved to a room, or a configured energy role pointing at a nonexistent ID
nodes.norm_label: self-explanatory empty states (go to areas, missing energy entity id)

nodes.label: Forceable demo scenarios (?demo&scenario=…)
nodes.rationale: Pure data patches to SEED/DEMO_CONFIG so a scenario runs exactly the code a real install runs; partial and missing are the most important

nodes.label: Single-ring energy fallback
nodes.rationale: With no grid-export sensor the ring falls back to a single ring rather than guessing; 1.5.4 and 1.6.0 fixed instantaneous values mixed into its daily-totals sentences

nodes.label: Three-layer camera live view (HLS / hls.js / fast stills)
nodes.rationale: Old MJPEG camera_proxy_stream substitution was a black rectangle on RTSP/ONVIF/generic cameras (most installs); first working layer wins, stills labeled 'preview refreshing' to never pretend to be live

Re-fetch hourly stats only when the wall clock crosses into a new hour, riding the existing 15s tick.
Snapshot refresh suspended while page hidden: on a wall tablet avoids continuous background fetches nobody sees.
Detail view auto-closes after 120 s.
WebRTC failure restarts the ladder minus WebRTC: skipWebRtc:true and carryDiag {failedLayer:'webrtc', failDetail} so Diagnostica shows the fallback.
Final layer: camera_proxy stills, so the view always degrades to something moving instead of a black rectangle.

v2: WebRTC first when be.ws/be.subscribe exist, RTCPeerConnection exists and camera/capabilities lists web_rtc in frontend_stream_types — same path as HA's own camera card, live in a second or two with no HLS segments.
v1.9.0: hls.js first wherever MediaSource exists; Chrome's native player answers 'maybe' but cannot parse HA's fMP4/HEVC streams (DEMUXER_ERROR_COULD_NOT_PARSE on a real Imou).
For the webrtc layer the ref sets el.srcObject to the MediaStream held in this._camWebRtc.stream; a stable ref per (layer,url) avoids React re-running it every render (14 reloads in 10 s measured).
No frame within 12 s (WEBRTC_START_TIMEOUT_MS), an error event, or ICE failed -> fall back to HLS.
Both own this._camWebRtc session state (pc, stream, sub, timer, candidate queue).
A layer that fails while playing steps down hlsjs -> native -> stills instead of leaving a black box.
Diagnostica camera rows read this.camDiag written by _setCamDiag; WebRTC gets its own label and omits the camera/stream note since WebRTC never asks for camera/stream.
Load-chained, not fixed 400 ms timer: a still from a slow ONVIF camera took 8.5 s, so a fixed timer aborted every frame.
_camStillGen generation counter invalidates in-flight still chains.
onEmbedIframe writes this.panelEmbedIframe, read by diagEnvironment(); instance field to avoid an extra render.
Checked once at boot so a valve whose time passed while nothing was open closes on the next dashboard that opens.
Reuses the statistic ids _resolveEnergyDaily resolved (config, then HA Energy prefs, then auto-discovery).
diagHourlyValue distinguishes state.hourlyEnergy undefined (loading) from null (no statistics).
Captures resolution facts as plain data (this.energyDiag) so Diagnostica renders them without re-running resolution.
Colours follow the role grammar: sage = self-consumption, acc (terracotta) = grid import, feed = export.
Normalises W/kW/MW to the powerUnit pref; forcing ' kW' was wrong by 1000x for half the inverters. Unknown units shown raw.
consumo = produzione + prelievo - immissione + scarica - carica; only when no explicit consumption sensor and all three base roles resolve.
Both read/write _batterySignBuffer: one sample per ~10s over 3 min, suspect when >=5 samples and >50% negative.
Room summary 'in corso' must agree with the room panel's three-tier plug state.
Single point for every service call: logged in the 20-entry _actionLog ring buffer and failures reach the screen; never rejects so call sites stay fire-and-forget.
A code_format entity fails without code, so gated actions open the PIN pad; the code lives only in state.pin and is never logged (call records entity and service, not data).
Recent actions rows read the _actionLog ring buffer maintained by call().
Both maintain state.irrigationEnds; _irrigationClosing guards double turn_off.
spark() produces polyline points, which must be set via a ref callback like _bindAttr since the HTML parser acts on points before JS runs.
Same discoverRooms call with isHidden always false so the settings screen can list hidden rooms to un-hide them.
A drag past 10px cancels the 600ms long-press timer; covers deliberately have no data-entity-id so slider drags never trigger hide.
settingsTabs hasIssue is kept in sync with _settingsProblemTab's criteria, but computed from the rows already built.
ctx supp/alarmNeedsCodeArm/alarmNeedsCodeDisarm come from vmAlarm's output via renderVals.
ctx hasNewRing comes from vmEnergyRing.
ctx batterySign and consumptionDisplayWatts come from vmLiveConsumption.
energyEmptyState from vmEnergyEmpty wins over either ring.
Strip only renders when vmEnergyRing's hasNewRing is true.
